items.name: The Greyford satchel
items.text: A courier's leather satchel, charred on one side. Inside: an order to sound the retreat at Greyford, signed in the Queen's name and sealed with the Lord Marshal's seal, and a private note in the same hand: 'To the horn-post only. Halvard is not to see it. V. C.'

items.name: The Tarrow bell
items.text: A small bronze chapel bell, green with twelve years of pond water. Forty-one names are scratched round its lip, in a careful, blocky hand.

items.name: Halvard's longsword
items.text: A plain, beautifully balanced knight's sword with an ember worked into the pommel. Ash still comes out of the grooves in the blade, no matter how often you clean it.

items.name: Ashen half-plate
items.text: Order of Ash plate, scorched dark and refitted with new straps. The ember on the breastplate has been polished bright again.

items.name: Reaver's axe
items.text: A heavy-bearded northern axe with a haft wrapped in greasy leather. It has seen a lot of doors.

items.name: Ember of the Order
items.text: A small enamelled ember on a pin, given to those the Order of Ash names as a friend. Knights in the Marches nod to it on the road.

items.name: Ember lily
items.text: A red lily that grows only in burned ground. The petals are warm to the touch, which nobody has ever satisfactorily explained.

items.name: Honey brittle
items.text: Sticky amber brittle with heath-seeds in it, wrapped in a twist of cloth. Refugee children trade it like coin.

items.name: Ash-baked bread
items.text: A flat loaf baked in the embers of a camp fire. Gritty, hot and better than it has any right to be.

items.name: Mother Hesk's tea
items.text: A stoppered flask of black, bitter tea brewed from heath roots. It tastes like penance and works like a draught.

items.name: Thorn Choir hymnal
items.text: A little book of hymns bound in briar bark. Every song in it is three notes long and about sleeping.

items.name: Bellrope knot
items.text: A short length of new bellrope, tied in a knight's knot. Corin cut it from the Tarrow rope and gave it to you without a word.

items.name: Corin's ring
items.text: A plain iron ring stamped inside with an ember and the name Ashdown. His father gave it to him on the day he was knighted. He gave it to you on a much better one.
